reason: The shared daemon and free-first-five-humans fit my multi-agent setup, but $30/seat adds up fast and I won't pay to be the first person vetting a tool with no Reddit, GitHub, or Twitter signal — my agents' credentials aren't a guinea pig.
objection: No reviews, no GitHub issues, no social proof; I'm not trusting an unproven local daemon with my credentials at $30/seat.
would_change_my_mind: A peer I trust vouches for it after using it, and it shows up in real GitHub issues/discussions.
